name: ai.usestring/web-access
title: String Web Access
description: Search the web, fetch any URL and map a site as clean, LLM-ready Markdown.

environmentVariables.name: STRING_AI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your String API key (get one at portal.usestring.ai). Without one, fetch and search run within a free daily allowance and the other tools are not listed.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <your String API key>. Leave it out to sign in with your String account instead.
